invariants.rationale: The event parameter is likely expected to be non-null for meaningful click handling.
GUI widget coordinates are usually non-negative (origin at top-left), making negative x values uncommon.
GUI widget coordinates are usually non-negative (origin at top-left), making negative y values uncommon.
The event parameter is statically declared as InputEvent, so it will always be an instance of InputEvent.
Coordinates such as x are expected to be finite values (neither NaN nor infinity) for meaningful processing.
